final: SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS project_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry)) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) * 1.0 / AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry)) OVER () AS ratio_to_average FROM scanqc AS q JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = q.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux
